content.title: What Are the Personality Traits of an Aries? A Complete Guide to the Zodiac Sign
content.text: Aries season, which begins in mid-March and ends in mid-April, marks the beginning of the astrological calendar and aligns with the spring equinox. This placement gives way to some of Aries’ best-known qualities, such as being energetic, natural-born leaders and highly motivated. Astrologer and best-selling author Lisa Stardust says that because they are the first sign of the astrological calendar, Aries are “known for their boldness, adventurous spirit, passion and confidence.” Celebrity astrologer Kyle Thomas also tells PEOPLE that in 2025, they will find themselves "seeking closure" around their past and will "receive karma for the good or the bad." "You’ll be setting up new patterns across the board that could affect the upcoming three decades of your life," Thomas says. "So choose wisely on where you place your attention." From personality traits to compatibility, here is everything to know about the Aries zodiac sign. What are the Aries dates? In 2025, Aries season spans from March 20 to April 19. Stardust adds that Aries is the first sign of the zodiac and aligns with the spring equinox, which, this year, is on March 20. What are the key personality traits of an Aries? Bell says that Aries are natural leaders and tend to be proactive. “They don’t like to sit around and plan, they would much rather be jumping headfirst into new experiences,” she explains. "They can be very upfront and direct, and they’re also skilled at initiating and bringing enthusiasm and high energy to new projects.” Bell and Stardust note that Aries’ energetic personality can be negatively misconstrued as aggression or impulsiveness. “However, it is their perseverance, self-reliance, vigor and zeal that propel them to great heights, as they possess an unbridled enthusiasm and fierce determination for everything they do,” Stardust adds. Which zodiac signs are most compatible with Aries? Stardust and Bell agree that Aries tend to get along best with fellow fire signs Leo and Sagittarius as well as air signs Aquarius and Gemini. “They have a similar way of looking at the world, and they too are more up for experimenting and taking risks,” Bell explains. “These signs tend to be more outgoing and social like Aries as well.” Stardust points out that Aries can get along with the third air sign, Libra, under certain circumstances. “The compatibility between Aries and Libra, another air sign, depends on whether Aries is receptive to slowing down and listening to Libra, who emphasizes the importance of finding balance in life,” she says. In relationships, Stardust says Aries are known for being passionate and taking initiative. “They enjoy pursuing others, making them feel in control of matters, but it's important for them to step back and let others reciprocate those feelings,” she explains. “By doing all the work, it can be refreshing to have someone do it for them.” Which zodiac signs are least compatible with Aries? Aries may struggle to form strong connections with Virgo, Pisces, Taurus and Capricorn. Bell points out that Aries may be too impulsive and chaotic for the strategic and plan-loving Virgo, and too blunt for emotionally-sensitive Pisces. The spontaneity of Aries may also clash with Taurus’ desire to stick to a routine. “Taurus can be stubborn and very set in their own ways, and once they find a routine they like, they don’t really see the point in changing it,” Bell explains. “They may not appreciate Aries’ desire to shake things up and always be embarking on a new adventure.” Stardust also points to Capricorn as a potential foe of Aries. “Capricorn and Aries may struggle to get along because of their tendency to clash, especially at work and on their way to achieving success,” she says. “As both are cardinal signs [signs that begin at equinoxes or solstices] and initiators of two opposing seasons, Aries can be more hot-headed, while Capricorn can be more level-headed, leading to lukewarm feelings between them.” How does Aries season affect Aries in 2025? Astrologer Valerie Mesa tells PEOPLE that Aries season in 2025 will be a "transformative" time for these placements. "On March 27, Venus retrograde slips back into Pisces — your 12th house of secrets, healing and unconscious patterns — stirring up some emotional baggage," Mesa says. "This is all about reflection — perhaps revisiting past relationships or healing wounds you thought were long buried. It's like scrolling through your old text messages only to realize you’ve still got some letting go to do." Then during the partial solar eclipse on March 29, Mesa added that "a powerful breakthrough" may come their way to encourage "cutting ties with something or someone that’s been holding you back." Neptune is then set to enter Aries on March 30 to "give you a wave of dreamy inspiration and creativity. You will be all the more receptive to your surroundings. Staying grounded is key." "With the sun energizing and revitalizing you as of March 20, it’s your turn to shine as your birthday season begins," she notes. "Whether you’re planning a birthday bash, launching a new project or making a major life decision, you’re the main character of this story." Which celebrities are Aries? Left: Lady Gaga arrives at the 61st Annual GRAMMY Awards on February 10, 2019 in Los Angeles, California. Center: Pedro Pascal poses at the 30th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards on February 24, 2024 in Los Angeles, California. Right: Robert Downey Jr. attends the 2024 Vanity Fair Oscar Party on March 10, 2024 in Beverly Hills, California. Steve Granitz/WireImage ; Steve Granitz/FilmMagic ; Daniele Venturelli/Getty Some of the most well-known Aries celebrities are Lady Gaga, Pedro Pascal and Robert Downey Jr. “A common theme across these Aries celebrities is that they are trailblazers in their respective fields,” says Bell. “They’re willing to take risks and pivot within their work when they feel the urge to do so, such as Lady Gaga being so daring with her fashion choices, and also moving from music into acting. Meanwhile, Robert Downey Jr. has become known for his very Aries-like superhero roles in action-packed movies like Iron Man or The Avengers.” Pascal, who has proved himself an acting powerhouse with roles like Joel in HBO’s The Last of Us, referred to his star sign as “the best and the worst.” “We don’t do in-between,” he said in a 2023 interview with MTV. Other celebrity Aries include Victoria Beckham, Sarah Jessica Parker, Reese Witherspoon, Emma Watson, Mariah Carey and Elton John.
